Create a finished, highly detailed architectural speculation drawing for Adam's G3 project, Ribera de Curtidores 31, El Rastro Madrid: collective temporary housing, about 40 young adults / 20 dwelling units, not a megastructure. This is an unbuilt design hypothesis, never a factual rendering of an existing building. Grounded in narrow deep infill site approximately 14.9m street front and up to 49.5m deep, irregular 651m2 plot, taller attached neighboring buildings; no freestanding suburban complex. Radical left-wing, feminist, cooperative, cheeky punk spirit embodied by shared space, mutual aid, resident agency and anti-speculative common ownership. Dignity and beauty, no poverty fetish or dystopia. Private rooms have real doors, daylight, furniture and acoustic boundaries; the communal is chosen. Permanent elegant construction, never stacked shipping containers, tent dwellings, capsule beds or a modular pod hotel. Graphic language: high-end experimental architecture-school drawing, very fine graphite/black CAD-like linework, gorgeous inhabited cutaways, white paper, pale grey urban context, selective flat saturated accents magenta for collective action/circulation, mint for vegetation, yellow for sun, muted material colors. Mixed-media cutout people and precise material textures, playful self-organized lived-in atmosphere. Prefer a dominant spatial drawing (80% of image) with up to 2 small explanatory details, legible large forms, no infographic cards, no decorative borders, no fake dimensions, no gibberish annotations, no English labels. Landscape 3:2 high resolution. Only the following requested short Spanish text, with clear editorial type; no long paragraphs.
Specific image brief: Narrative architectural drawing of the SAME common entry, stair and small private unit seen in three chronological vignettes across one continuous white-page section. Arrival: young adult with suitcase welcomed at shared table and gets their own room key, personal storage. Inhabiting: adds a hand-made shelf and plants, uses workshop and makes dinner with neighbors, private stable room. Departure: takes personal things, leaves plant/shelf and message in collective archive, another resident welcomed. Emphasize stable dignified housing through a period of life, NEVER forced daily bed sharing or hot-bedding. Draw continuous robust architecture in grey, residents' objects in magenta/mint, archive wall with small pinned sheets no gibberish. Caption '15 / PERTENECER SIN QUEDARSE', 'LLEGAR', 'HABITAR', 'DEJAR HUELLA'.
